payload.description_as_reported: Scarcity versus abundance broadens the discrepancy between the liking of the favorite and nonfavorite items and leads to a greater choice share of the favorite item.
payload.pattern: Apply a {visual_emphasis_style} highlight to the user's most-preferred item in a list when its remaining inventory falls below {inventory_threshold_count} units to amplify preference under scarcity.

decision_note: Approved as extracted. Anchor sc-06-02 Limited-quantity scarcity, capped grade C+; cap discharged upstream on the anchor, confidence unchanged. Reacts to real inventory falling below a threshold and highlights an item the user already prefers; it neither invents a limit nor applies repeated pressure, which is what separated it from repeated-view-scarcity-nudge (D-332).
